messages.author: 2146c6462796e05f
messages.subject: hyperprior horseshoe prior
parts:
Dear developers,

Juho Piironen and Aki Vehtari recently published a very nice paper regarding the hyperprior for the global shrinkage parameter in the horseshoe prior (https://arxiv.org/pdf/1610.05559v1.pdf). They showed that the default choice for the global shrinkage parameter (half-cauchy with scale 1) is suboptimal. To my best knowledge, it is currently not possible to adjust the scale of this half-cauchy in the horseshoe prior using rstanarm. Are you planning to make this possible? Or can I do it myself? I think the only thing that needs to be adjusted (for glm's in rstanarm/inst/chunks/priors_glm.stan) is line 16:
target += normal_lpdf(global[1] | 0, 1);
to
target += normal_lpdf(global[1] | 0, scale_global);
in which scale global is a user defined real.

Thanks!
